observations.claim: Fuelmaps reported bid-heavy resting depth across six named spot venues at 11:00 UTC.
disconfirming_or_limiting: Resting orders can be cancelled or layered.
A later price move below previously reported perpetual bid walls shows a static bid-heavy snapshot is not proof of durable demand.

observations.claim: Swiftedge's 17:30 UTC reference was $0.9566, down 0.56% over 24 hours and 8.39% over seven days; the page explicitly labels the market perpetual futures.
disconfirming_or_limiting: Not a spot quote.
A different Swiftedge page earlier in the day showed positive 24-hour flow and a higher price; snapshots use different rolling windows.

observations.claim: OptimistFi reported $1.8B OI across 38 venues at 18:39 UTC, while TradRadar reported $1.31B across seven exchanges at 15:35 UTC.
disconfirming_or_limiting: Different venue universes and timestamps.
Funding units and weighting differ; do not average or infer one canonical OI from these snapshots.

observations.claim: OptimistFi's 38-venue OI-weighted funding was -7.6% annualized, while TradRadar's seven-venue OI-weighted funding was +0.0011% per eight hours.
disconfirming_or_limiting: Different venue sets, weighting, update times and rate units prevent direct sign comparison without normalization.

observations.claim: Fuelmaps' Deribit snapshot showed ATM implied volatility near 80% for near expiries and its 928-day backtest summary reported 20 three-sigma breaches (2.2%) versus a 0.27% normal reference.
disconfirming_or_limiting: Provider's historical backtest is not independently reproduced.
Options sample and settlement convention differ from spot/linear perps.

observations.claim: CryptoKeyhole showed a partial 16 November outflow of 5.197M XRP with only two of four daily reporters received.
disconfirming_or_limiting: Not a complete daily total.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Bid-heavy resting spot depth is not sufficient evidence of durable demand or near-term price support.
disconfirming_or_missing: No raw order-level add/cancel/trade tape captured.
Different providers and spot/perpetual market types.
competing_hypotheses.test: Capture timestamped multi-venue order-book deltas and executed trades; measure wall survival and price impact.

competing_hypotheses.claim: OI divergence is predominantly explained by venue universe, instrument coverage and timestamp differences rather than a single provider being necessarily wrong.
disconfirming_or_missing: No common venue-by-venue synchronized extract or contract-level reconciliation.
competing_hypotheses.test: Normalize identical venues, contract types, currencies, timestamps and mark-price conventions.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Funding sign disagreement is driven by venue dispersion and provider weighting/cadence; aggregate funding should not be treated as one market-wide sentiment value.
disconfirming_or_missing: Provider methodologies are not fully independently reproduced.
competing_hypotheses.test: Capture venue-level funding at synchronized timestamps and recompute common-weight aggregates.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The apparent ETF flow disagreement is a reporting-completeness problem until all issuer files for the same fund universe and date are reconciled.
disconfirming_or_missing: Only two of four expected daily reporters had published in the cited snapshot.
competing_hypotheses.test: Reconcile each issuer's daily holdings file and the same fund universe after publication.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBI START Bonds create a real JPY debt issuance and a separate, much smaller XRP reward purchase program; the bond amount must not be classified as XRP capital.
disconfirming_or_missing: Actual XRP purchase and distribution quantity is not disclosed in the inspected sources.
competing_hypotheses.test: Find issuer confirmation of the XRP purchased/distributed and reconcile recipient eligibility.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The SBI Digital Finance/Doppler agreement may enable future institutional XRP collateral and lending, but no current deployed capital or live product is established by the announcement.
disconfirming_or_missing: No financial terms, named institutions, product launch or live lending metrics disclosed.
competing_hypotheses.test: Require product documentation, custody/segregation details, executed transactions and independently verified AUM.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The 60%-cheaper/under-four-second Japanese bank pilot claim is not yet reliable evidence of production XRP payment throughput.
disconfirming_or_missing: No named banks or primary performance records.
competing_hypotheses.test: Obtain named bank, corridor, baseline, sample size, transaction logs and independently audited latency/cost methodology.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The Dr. Kamilah Stevenson person is confirmed, but the candidate YouTube channel is not first-party verified and must not be attributed yet.
disconfirming_or_missing: No first-party link from her official site or verified social account to the candidate channel.
competing_hypotheses.test: Find a first-party cross-link or verified account post explicitly linking the channel.

data_quality.no_averaging_policy: Do not average spot and perpetual prices, provider OI aggregates, funding rates with different units, or partial ETF flows.
data_quality.source_independence_policy: Publisher identity is recorded; common upstream exchange feeds or data vendors have not been ruled out. Multiple dashboards from one publisher count as one source family.
data_quality.timestamp_policy: Use the explicit provider timestamp. If no exact timestamp is shown, preserve null and do not synthesize one.
source_limitations: Search/rendered-page extracts only; no original HTTP response bytes or SHA-256 receipts.
Market data aggregators may share upstream venue feeds.
Resting order books are cancellable and are not executed volume.
SBI XRP reward execution quantity remains unverified.
